Llama3-1B (1.54B and 1.23B parameters) for classification, and T5-Large (0.75B parameters) for
generation. Datasets include Financial Phrasebank, MRPC, BBC News, and Tweet Annotation for
classification; IWSLT2014, CNN/DailyMail, and Samsum for generation. Details are provided in
Appendix J.2. We employ LoRA fine-tuning via Transformers (Wolf et al., 2020) and PEFT (Man-
grulkar et al., 2022), with AdamW and a constant scheduler (lr = 1.5e-4). Performance is measured
using AUC and Empirical Privacy (Definition 4) for classification (Li et al., 2023a), and BLEU for
generation (Papineni et al., 2002). All experiments run on an NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU.
